rationale: Fire damage to the policyholder's own kitchen from a grease flare-up is a covered peril with no third-party fault.
severity_rationale: Moderate damage to kitchen cabinets and smoke damage throughout the kitchen, estimated loss likely $5,000–$50,000 range; no injuries; damage contained to one room.
claim_summary: Kitchen grease fire (sautéing onions) on evening of claim date; homeowner extinguished with fire extinguisher. Charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls; rest of house unaffected. No injuries. Policy POL-1001 (Alex Doe) covers property damage with $500 deductible and $250,000 limit. Medium severity.

case_facts.description: Grease fire on stove from sautéing onions; controlled with extinguisher
case_facts.damage_details: Charred kitchen cabinets above stove; smoke damage on ceiling and walls; rest of house unaffected
